local_review.finding_body: The latest-EA current-defaults and future-defaults-all jobs each exceeded the five-minute native-image limit while scanning artifacts for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows supplied by org.bytedeco:opencv-platform. The test exercises Loader.loadProperties and does not load OpenCV native binaries, so the aggregate runtime dependency was unnecessary. This is a contribution-local build-file defect repairable under FS-contribution-contract.5.1.
local_review.finding_title: Avoid aggregate Bytedeco platform artifacts in metadata-only preset tests
local_review.fix_note: Removed testRuntimeOnly org.bytedeco:opencv-platform from the contribution's build.gradle while preserving the test and all assertions. Verified ./gradlew clean test in current-defaults and future-defaults-all modes; native-image builds completed in about 55 seconds and the native test passed. Also verified checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, spotlessCheck, git diff --check, and fissile check --staged.
local_review.review_comment: Both required latest-EA metadata-test lanes timed out after the aggregate opencv-platform dependency put every supported platform artifact on the native-image classpath; the logs showed roughly 60,000 scanned entries and 1.44 GiB of registered resources. I removed that unnecessary runtime aggregate, reviewed the complete single-coordinate diff under the library-new-request rules, and found no remaining blocking issue. Current-defaults and future-defaults-all native tests now pass, as do metadata validation, Checkstyle, Spotless, diff checks, and fissile.
